title: Fix median_cents for even-length amount lists
body: median_cents in ledgerlite/stats.py returns the wrong value when the input has an even number of amounts. Repro: median_cents([100, 200, 300, 400]) returns 300, expected 250 (the average of the two middle values 200 and 300). Its docstring already specifies that even counts average the two middle values. Odd-count medians are correct and all existing tests pass. Fix the even-count case and add a regression test covering it.
